manual.title: Connect to your VIDAA TV
manual.description: Enter the TV's IP address. The TV must be on and mobile remote control must be enabled. Adding its MAC address can help identify it and connect to newer VIDAA firmware.

data.name: Name
data.mac: TV MAC address (optional; helps connection and Wake-on-LAN)

scan.title: Find TVs on your local network
scan.description: The scan checks enabled local IPv4 networks for the VIDAA service on port {port}. If no TVs are found, confirm that Home Assistant and the TV are on the same LAN, then scan again or use manual setup.

dhcp_confirm.title: New VIDAA TV discovered
dhcp_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Continue to pair this TV?

reconfigure.title: Update VIDAA TV connection
reconfigure.description: Change the TV address, display name, or MAC address used for VIDAA authentication and Wake-on-LAN.

data.name: Name
data.mac: TV MAC address (optional; helps connection and Wake-on-LAN)

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the TV again
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the PIN displayed on the TV screen to restore Home Assistant access.

pair.title: Pair with the TV
pair.description: Enter the PIN code shown on the TV screen.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV. Check the IP address, network, and that the TV is on.
error.invalid_auth: The TV rejected the PIN. Please try again.
error.no_tvs_found: No VIDAA TVs were found on the enabled local networks.
error.scan_failed: Home Assistant could not scan the local networks. Try again or enter the TV address manually.
error.connection_timeout: The TV address responded, but the secure MQTT connection did not complete in time. Make sure the TV is awake, on the same LAN, and mobile remote control is enabled. Check the Home Assistant log for the connection stage.
error.connection_failed: Home Assistant could not complete the TV's secure MQTT connection. Check the TV's mobile remote setting and the Home Assistant log for the TLS/MQTT reason.
error.mqtt_handshake_failed: The TV closed the secure MQTT connection before setup completed. This can happen when the TV requires a different VIDAA authentication method. Check mobile remote settings and share the TV model, firmware, and Home Assistant log details.
error.mqtt_auth_rejected: The TV rejected the MQTT client credentials before PIN pairing. Home Assistant tried the supported VIDAA authentication profiles. Confirm mobile remote control is enabled and that the TV is on a supported VIDAA firmware.
error.mqtt_connection_rejected: The TV rejected the MQTT connection. Check that mobile remote control is enabled and review the Home Assistant log for the broker response.

abort.not_vidaa_tv: The discovered device does not expose the VIDAA service.
abort.no_host: The discovered TV did not provide a network address.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the VIDAA TV at {host}. Check that it is on and reachable on your local network.

invalid_auth.message: The TV rejected Home Assistant's connection. Pair it again to restore access.

pairing_required.message: This TV is no longer paired with Home Assistant. Enter the TV's pairing PIN to reconnect.

invalid_command.message: The requested key is not supported by the VIDAA TV.

invalid_source.message: The selected input is not available on this TV.

mac_required.message: Enter the TV's MAC address to turn it on with Wake-on-LAN.
